parameters.name: Scenario
parameters.description:
The scenario. Valid values:

- 1: SMS satisfaction survey.
- 2: used in IVR flows.
- 3: missed call SMS.

The parameter name **Scenario.1** indicates that the SMS configuration for only one scenario is retrieved. To retrieve SMS configurations for multiple scenarios, specify Scenario.1, Scenario.2, and so on. Refer to the request examples below.
